steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Who decides what" [level=1]
  - note:
    - paragraph: "Preview Checked when an automation is made and tested. Not yet enforced while it runs: that needs named approvers, which are planned."
  - status: Works now Version 1 saved.
  - paragraph: "One step left: Started by one person. Rules need a second person to approve changes; until then, you approved your own setup. Review within 14 days."
  - heading "People and roles" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: "You: Admin, Builder, Approver, Rule owner, Auditor"
    - listitem: "Dana: Approver, Rule owner"
  - heading "Who approves what" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: "Money going out: above €250 needs Dana's yes"
    - listitem: "A message leaving the company: always needs your yes"
  - heading "Rules that never break" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: Money out above €250 needs Dana's yes; whoever asked for it can't approve it. Org policy Preview (shows what it would stop)
  - button "Change it"
  - link "Try it on a card":
    - /url: "#/make/expense-approval"
  - group: Show details

- main:
  - list "Steps":
    - listitem: "Step 1 of 4: Choose"
    - listitem: "Step 2 of 4: Test"
    - listitem: "Step 3 of 4: Turn on"
    - listitem: "Step 4 of 4: Use your own list"
  - heading "Approve small expenses" [level=1]
  - region "I'll do this:":
    - heading "I'll do this:" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Read the submitted expense claims
      - listitem: Approve automatically each claim up to 250 that has a receipt
      - listitem: Record every decision in the expense-decisions sheet
      - listitem: E-mail the address you give the claims that need a decision, after you approve the send
      - listitem: Check that nothing over the limit was approved, and re-read the outbox and the decisions sheet
    - group: "It won't:"
  - heading "A few questions" [level=2]
  - text: Up to what amount should it approve on its own?
  - paragraph: €250 · Set by Dana (Org policy)
  - spinbutton "Up to what amount should it approve on its own?": "250"
  - paragraph: "Why I'm asking: A wrong limit would approve spending you would refuse. I will not guess it. If you skip: Nothing is built until you choose a limit."
  - paragraph: Set in Who decides what. You can make it stricter here, not looser.
  - text: Who decides the bigger ones? (their e-mail)
  - textbox "Who decides the bigger ones? (their e-mail)":
    - /placeholder: name@yourbusiness.com
  - paragraph: "Why I'm asking: Expense details go to this person; I will not guess who it is. If you skip: Nothing is built: the bigger claims have to go to someone."
  - group "Who decides the bigger ones?":
    - text: Who decides the bigger ones?
    - radio "The person you named gets an e-mail, and you record the decision here Free" [checked]
    - text: The person you named gets an e-mail, and you record the decision here Free
    - radio "The person you named decides, and their yes is recorded as theirs"
    - text: The person you named decides, and their yes is recorded as theirs
    - button "Team plan"
    - radio "Just me, nobody else needs to know Free"
    - text: Just me, nobody else needs to know Free
  - region "Settings already chosen for you":
    - heading "Settings already chosen for you" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Change any of them now, or later.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "Needs a receipt to be approved on its own: Yes"
        - button "Change"
      - listitem:
        - text: "Tell people when their claim is approved: No"
        - button "Change"
  - term: "Uses AI:"
  - definition: No, it follows fixed steps.
  - term: "Where your data goes:"
  - definition: Nowhere. It reads the list you give it and writes on this computer.
  - term: "When it runs:"
  - definition: Only when you press Run. There is no schedule yet.
  - status
  - button "Test it with pretend claims"
  - link "Back to all automations":
    - /url: "#/"
  - paragraph: The test uses pretend data and a pretend inbox. Nothing real is sent.
